lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters organized into distinct vertical columns posterior to the gill slits, with inter-centroid distance increasing moving posteriorly.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated intensity that intersect with the circular high-luminance blobs to form a regular grid-like pattern on the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A sharp horizontal feature on the upper third of the flank exhibiting a pronounced vertical intensity gradient, with light reflectance on the dorsal edge and shadow on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Three distinct elongated high-contrast silhouettes representing commensal organisms (remoras) are visible: one on the upper mid-flank, one near the pectoral fin trailing edge, and one swimming below the pectoral fin.
